glosses: shadow (a dark image projected onto a surface where light (or other radiation) is blocked by the shade of an object)
shade (darkness where light, particularly sunlight, is blocked)

examples.en: There's no light without a shadow.

examples.text: Tiene miedo de su propia sombra.
examples.en: He is afraid of his own shadow.

examples.text: Ellos se escondieron en las sombras.
examples.en: They hid themselves in the shadows.

examples.text: Su sombra en la pared parecía triste.
examples.en: His shadow on the wall looked sad.
